commits.headline: refactor(port): make_image's Image owned without a raw new or delete
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The Vulkan backend's make_image allocated its Image with a raw new and
freed it with delete in the shared pointer's deleter. The image code is
about to move into a file of its own (P1-02 of the restructure), and the
conventions check gates raw new and delete in new C++ files, so the

engine.py is rac3-decomp's permuter_engine.py made game-agnostic: worker
processes run decomp-permuter's randomizer and compile each candidate
with the profile's steps, score.py scores it, and a 0 goes to the game's
checker; only its EXACT ends a run as matched, and a 0 it rejects
scores 1. Results go to build/permuter/<profile>/<func>/ with a
result.json naming the best clean candidate.

accept.py applies WORKFLOW.md's acceptance rule where a program can:
duplicated calls in both branches,…

commits.headline: feat(tools): permuter queue runner for the build machines
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Generalised from the boxes' run_queue.py: one queue directory per
machine with items of any profile (queue.tsv), done.tsv, PAUSE and STOP,
each run under nice -n 10, at most --slots runs of -j workers and no
start while the load average is at or above --max-load. A WIN (score
0, checker EXACT, no artefacts) writes its function to wins/.
import-legacy reads the boxes' old rac3 queue without changing it.

commits.headline: fix(tools): end a permuter run whose workers died silently
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A worker that fails before it reports (an import error in the spawned
process) left the collector waiting for ever. The collector now ends
the run as an error once no worker is alive.

commits.headline: test(tools): tools/permuter on synthetic objects and assembly
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The scorer on hand-made splat lines and a hand-made ELF object
(relocated fields, a wrong callee, a changed offset, a missing
instruction, branches through the alignment), the ELF reader, the
profile helpers and every profile file, the queue's verdicts and
records, the patch stamp, and accept.py's three artefacts (skipped
without a decomp-permuter checkout).

commits.headline: refactor(port): common/log.cpp reads OPENRAC_LOG through common/env.h
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The log's level came from getenv("OPENRAC_LOG") at static
